reading_hypothesis: An owned Intern value separates reuse from publication. Discovery produces either an existing table/ID or a single pending publication containing the reverse append result; commit is the only place allowed to finish that publication. This gives both success paths one terminal interpretation without a recursive transition loop.
distinct_from_01: Finite prepare/commit composition instead of one recursively interpreted phase enum.
fixed_inputs: Every non-main .bend file is copied unchanged from packages/symbols.
